    Has Elche ever beaten Barcelona?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Yes, Elche has beaten Barcelona, but it's been a very long time, with their last official win against them dating back to the 1974/75 season, a 1-0 victory during the Cruyff era; Barcelona has dominated the fixture since, remaining unbeaten against Elche in La Liga for decades. 
    Key Points:
    • Last Victory:
      Elche's most recent win against Barcelona was a 1-0 home victory in the 1974/75 season. 
    • Long Unbeaten Streak:
      Barcelona has held a significant advantage, going undefeated in their La Liga matches against Elche for over 20 games, including winning the last eight in a row at one point. 
    • Away Record:
      Elche has never won at Camp Nou, with their record there being 12 defeats and 7 draws in La Liga. 
    • Overall Head-to-Head:
      While Barcelona leads the overall record, Elche has secured victories in the past, though not in recent decades.

      Has Madrid lost a final?
      An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
      AI Overview
      Yes, Real Madrid has lost UEFA Champions League (formerly European Cup) finals, though they have an exceptional record, losing only three of their 17 finals in the competition, specifically in 1962 (vs. Benfica), 1964 (vs. Inter Milan), and 1981 (vs. Liverpool). Since their 1981 loss, Real Madrid has won every Champions League final they have participated in, extending a remarkable winning streak in the final match.
       
      Key defeats in European Cup/Champions League Finals: 
      • 1962: Lost 5-3 to Benfica.
      • 1964: Lost 3-1 to Inter Milan.
      • 1981: Lost 1-0 to Liverpool.
